claims.text: Prompt engineering is the process of structuring inputs to large language models.
Self-consistency, chain of thought, and generated knowledge are advanced prompt engineering methodologies.
Prompt engineering strategies can defend against adversarial attacks that exploit vulnerabilities in large language models.

evidence.description: The abstract defines prompt engineering as the process of structuring inputs to maximize the utility and accuracy of language models.
The authors list self-consistency, chain of thought, and generated knowledge as advanced prompt engineering methodologies.
The paper highlights the role of prompt engineering in AI security, specifically for defending against adversarial attacks on LLMs.
